question: Which of the following festivals of Tamil Nadu is dedicated to Lord Muruga?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thai Poosam.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thai poosam**__ is a festival celebrated by the Tamil Hindu community mainly in south India.
 
• Thai Poosam festival is **dedicated to Lord Muruga.**
 
• Lord Muruga is the son of Shiva and Parvati.
 
• The word Thaipoosam is a combination of the name of a month and the name of a star.
 
• The festival is also observed in Kerala as **Thaipooyam.**
 
• It is believed that Thaipusam marks **Lord Muruga's birthday.**
 
• It is a celebration of the victory of good over evil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Onam** is the most popular festival in Kerala.

 
 
• It is a harvest festival that commemorates the annual visit of mythical king Mahabali.
 
 
 
• **Aadi Perukku** is a Tamil festival celebrated in south India.
 
 
• It is celebrated on the 18th day of the Tamil month of Adi.
 
 
 
• **Pongal** is a multi-day harvest festival of South India among the Tamil community.
